name: Springwood
aka: Home of Franklin D. Roosevelt National Historic Site

dates.built: c. 1793; Italianate villa c. 1850; enlarged and recast in the Colonial Revival 1915-16
dates.altered: The NPS: 'The 1915 alterations resulted in extensive changes to the house interior including the raising of the central roof to create a full third floor, expansion of the entrance hall, addition of the living room and a large suite of bedrooms above, and enlargement of the service areas.' Wikipedia: 'The home was more than doubled in size by adding two large fieldstone wings'.
dates.note: The NPS page: 'The original house was built about 1793 and later renovated into an Italianate style villa about 1850 ... The enlargement, completed in 1916'. The Wikipedia infobox prints 'Built 1800–1845' and 'Architectural style Federal, Italianate' for the whole site. Both kept; the exemplar year is the enlargement's completion.
